description: Send money to someone else (a Moneda user, a contact, or an external bank/wallet). Creates a payment request that requires user approval in the Moneda mobile app. Not for converting between the user's own currencies: use initiate_currency_exchange for that. Look up the recipient first via search_users, get_my_accounts, or get_contacts. Check balance with get_balance before calling. After calling, poll get_payment_status. Bank transfers require an active Iron account and a registered autoramp.

accountId.description: Account ID for transfer_account payments (from get_my_accounts)

amount.description: Amount in user-facing units (e.g. '50.00'). Must be greater than zero.

contactAccountId.description: Account ID for the contact's bank or wallet (contactAccountId from get_contacts). Required when a contact has multiple bank accounts or wallets.

contactUsername.description: Contact username or display name for transfer_contact_bank or transfer_contact_wallet. Accepts @username, username, or display name.

destinationChainId.description: Only Base ("eip155:8453") is accepted. Cross-chain payouts cannot be requested through an agent yet and are refused; the user can make them in the Moneda app. Only applies to transfer_contact_wallet.

paymentType.description: Type of payment: transfer_moneda (to a Moneda user), transfer_account (to own external account), transfer_contact_bank (to contact's bank), transfer_contact_wallet (to contact's wallet)

reference.description: Optional payment memo. For bank transfers: SEPA max 140 chars, ACH max 10 chars. Allowed: letters, numbers, spaces, and / - .

source.description: Where the money comes from. Omit to pay from the main balance.

kind.description: main (default): the checking balance. earnings: withdraw from the USD earnings vault (USD/EUR sends only). sub_account: pay from one of the user's single-signature sub-accounts (Base wallet recipients only; requires the write:sub_accounts scope).

subAccountId.description: Required when kind is sub_account (from list_sub_accounts)

name: initiate_payment
